audience: ecommerce brands and 3PL teams that ship orders through ShipMonk warehouses

useCases.title: Find orders that are waiting to ship
useCases.text: List the enabled warehouses, then list orders by status. Open one order to read its items and shipping data.

useCases.title: Review the orders shipped yesterday
useCases.text: List the orders in a shipped or updated time window, such as yesterday. Read the status and shipping data of each one.

useCases.title: Look up a product SKU and its status
useCases.text: Search the products by a text term and read the status, name and barcode of each SKU.

useCases.title: Track inbound deliveries and customer returns
useCases.text: List the inbound receivings by ASN or warehouse, and open one by its receiving key. List the customer returns with their desired action.

useCases.title: Create a new order and release it to the warehouse
useCases.text: Create an order once the items and address are confirmed. Submit it only when the warehouse should pick and ship it, because submission moves physical goods.
